# GAMG benchmark: phase times per configuration

Median (min-max) over 5 repetitions of the maximum over ranks of each phase [s], from `docs/benchmark_gamg_results.json` (`python/gamg_tables.py`). `pc_setup` and `ksp_solve` are PETSc's; `petsc_matrix` is the conversion of our CSR into the PETSc matrix. `total` is not the sum of the columns (the `solve` phase also holds the true-residual check, and maxima over ranks need not add up).
